static_traits.name: Wang Feina
static_traits.family_status: Living alone; parents have retired and live elsewhere
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends somewhat tense due to stress, reduced socializing; also have supportive friends and colleagues to talk with when facing difficulties
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before, no psychotherapy received yet
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, strong logic, high cooperation, positive attitude and willingness to try new methods

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and stressed due to heavy workload, affecting engagement in and enjoyment of personal hobbies.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this stress significantly affects my mental health and overall enjoyment of life.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough; if I cannot meet high standards I will be denied
Only by continuously being efficient and meeting all expectations am I valuable

special_situations.event: Workload has increased markedly, needing to handle multiple projects at once and face pressing deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete all tasks with high quality and on time simultaneously, it means I am incompetent and will be criticized
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overtime and self-pressure; sacrifices hobbies to devote to work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I simply cannot finish all the work, and have no time for hobbies.

special_situations.event: At the start of a busy work week, the schedule is packed with meetings and tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no whole block of free time, it means work and life cannot both be managed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives up social and interest activities in advance to avoid 'losing control'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This week there will definitely not be any free time; no hobbies can be done at all.

special_situations.event: Completing a project and receiving overall positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as feedback contains improvement suggestions, it means overall performance is not good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly focus on shortcomings, ignoring positive information
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even if there is praise, it shows I still have many problems.

special_situations.event: Anticipation about future work since workload increased six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is busy now, the future will stay this way; life can hardly recover balance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent worry, hard to relax; reduces attempts to engage in hobbies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will always be this busy from now on; I will hardly ever enjoy life well again.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to keep a sense of control over work and life
core_conflict.fear: Fear of failure and being criticized, being seen as incompetent
defense_goal: Preventing failure and criticism by maintaining high standards and self-harshness

object_relations.self_representation: A hardworking executor who may be denied at any time

manifestations: Work occupies the rhythm of life, and subjectively time feels bound by work, making it hard to choose to invest time in hobbies and socializing
outcomes: Anxiety and a sense of pressure rise
Decreased sense of control over life

manifestations: Reduced ability to enjoy life and hobbies; fewer social activities

positive_force: The ability, in most cases, to complete tasks on time and receive positive feedback
Willing to try new methods (cognitive restructuring, mindfulness, etc.) and capable of self-reflection
Has a support network of colleagues and friends to confide in
negative_force: A thinking style tending to predict the worst outcomes and overgeneralize
Mental filtering leads to ignoring positive feedback, focusing on shortcomings
Objective workload is high, handling multiple projects and urgent deadlines simultaneously
Sensitivity to criticism and dependence on external evaluation of self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: Work-related persistent anxiety and stress responses (tension, worry, difficulty relaxing)
antecedent: When a busy work week begins
When handling multiple projects with tight deadlines simultaneously
When seeing the schedule packed with meetings and tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Worry about being unable to meet high standards and being criticized; generalizing each stress situation into a persistent threat
target_behavior.function: Avoid the potential risk of failure and being denied; drive over-preparation and self-pressure to seek a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced work focus, efficiency affected; hobbies and socializing cut back, reduced life satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance (reduced socializing and investment in interest activities)
antecedent: When believing there is no whole block of free time
target_behavior.core_reason: Believing that without sacrificing leisure one will lose control or fail to meet standards; viewing relaxation as a risk
target_behavior.function: Reduce anxiety and sense of guilt in the short term, keeping more time to cope with work
target_behavior.consequence: Long-term pleasure and recovery capacity decline; social relationship tension; pressure experience further worsened
